title: THE FRACTURE
message: Something doesn't fit because it isn't supposed to.
meaning: The Fracture is not part of the normal progression. It appears when two paths, states or rules that should remain separate begin to overlap.
imageAlt: Official card artwork for The Fracture
mechanic: Rule-breaking ANOMALY card. It appears where the Citadel branch overlaps another state and permanently leaves FRACTURE_TRACE in the graph.
